claims.statement: For a deterministic Boolean endpoint on two fixed consumer inputs, observation of cells 00, 01 and 11 leaves exactly two compatible response functions; they differ only at 10.
claims.domain: All functions from {0,1}^2 to {0,1}, with fixed input semantics and one frozen context.
claims.proof: One of four truth-table bits remains free; exhaustive enumeration in model.py verifies all 16 functions and eight fibers of size two.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not identify biological mechanisms, real-valued curves, stochastic laws, actual intake, or experience. Monotonicity does not resolve the two named profiles.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Motor-only missing-corner thought experiment fixes consequence and varies consumer input.

claims.statement: For k unrelated endpoint functions observed on the same three cells, 2^k joint Boolean completions remain.
claims.domain: k finite Boolean endpoints without cross-endpoint constraints.
all_premises: independent admissibility of each endpoint completion
claims.proof: Cartesian product of k two-element completion fibers; executable checks for k=1 through 6.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: Known equality, factorization, monotonic cross-target or mechanistic constraints can reduce the count but must be independently warranted.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Endpoint vector keeps intensity, precision, agency, ownership and report distinct.

claims.statement: A complete four-cell endpoint table does not identify actual input-read occurrences.
claims.domain: Eager and short-circuit implementations of Boolean OR.
all_premises: declared eager and lazy execution semantics
claims.proof: Both implementations compute OR; on M=1 cells eager reads P and lazy does not. model.py records the event traces.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: A validated intake-event instrument or stronger sole-route/no-cancellation contract can separate the implementations.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch case holds output law fixed while changing actual consumption.

claims.statement: A full real-valued two-by-two table defines endpoint- and context-indexed controlled effects and an interaction; the active/passive contrast alone supplies only the P=1 motor contrast under intervention fidelity.
claims.domain: Four fixed-context endpoint means mu_00, mu_01, mu_10, mu_11.
claims.proof: Direct difference and difference-in-differences definitions in RESEARCH_NOTE.md C4.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: Inferring mu_10 from three cells assumes additivity/no interaction. Active/passive labels do not guarantee P or context is fixed.
claims.thought_experiment_role: The missing 10 cell is the precise functional discriminator.

claims.statement: Current primary studies require perceived intensity/bias, discrimination precision, agency and ownership to remain distinct endpoints and expose attention/body-state context as additional variables.
claims.domain: Only the cited protocols and inspected source scopes in SOURCE_SCOPE.md.
claims.proof: Source comparison in RESEARCH_NOTE.md C5 and SOURCE_SCOPE.md.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not prove a universal anatomical gate, exact OR computation, complete phenomenology or C1.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Passive goal-cue substitution is a rival to motor-only interpretation.

claims.statement: For one independently admitted actual same-instance token, grounded consumer relations are parts of actual organization and have experience-internal structural counterparts under C1, without thereby becoming agency, ownership, intensity, sensitivity, report or conceptual I.
claims.domain: One actual token, interval, complete common signature and independently grounded carriers/consumers/interventions/endpoints.
claims.proof: Direct same-instance application of UCT I v1.2 C1; no new causal or phenomenal variable is introduced.
claims.counterexamples_and_limits: No actual token or named endpoint bridge is admitted here. QC10, IA-QC11, QC12 and QC13 remain open.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Ancestors/formation case prevents a consumer comparison from becoming an experience-existence gate.
